name: Janit B
tagline: I build AI that people can actually use, not just models that look good in a notebook.
about: I'm in my final year of Computer Science at VIT Chennai, specialising in AI and Machine Learning. I like owning a project from start to finish: cleaning the data, training the model, putting it behind an API and building the screen someone finally clicks on.

That last step is my favourite part. A model only matters once a real person can open it, drop in their own file and get a useful answer back. Every project on this site works that way, so go ahead and try them.
highlights: I've trained and fine tuned deep learning models (ResNet50, LSTMs, transformers) for images, audio and time series.
I've built RAG pipelines with LangChain, FAISS and Whisper, so people can search through documents and meetings.
I build the whole product around a model: FastAPI services, streaming responses, React front ends and tests.
I tell you how a model really did. Accuracy per class, where it struggles and what it can't do, not just the headline number.
At my internship I built AI voice agents and automations that real e-commerce customers talked to.

experience.about: A Bangalore studio that builds websites, SaaS products, internal tools and AI agents for D2C and retail brands.
experience.title: AI & Software Engineering Intern
points: Built a real time AI voice agent with ElevenLabs that held conversations with customers and took over follow up work the team used to do by hand.
Connected those conversations to REST APIs using dynamic variables, so the agent could look up a customer's live order details in the middle of a call.
Looked after client Shopify stores: added new features, fixed bugs and kept them running smoothly.
Worked with a mixed team on live client projects, from the very first requirement all the way to the feature going live.
